item_short_desc: Rothco’s Pace Counter is a practical tool designed to help you accurately measure the distance you travel by foot. This pace counter features 13 durable plastic beads arranged in a 4-bead top section and a 9-bead lower section, making it easy to keep track of your paces. The approximately 18-inch long counter is crafted from durable polyester paracord, pre-tied for immediate use. Whether you're hiking, scouting, or engaged in outdoor survival activities, this pace counter ensures you can measure your progress efficiently.
description: Rothco’s Pace Counter is a practical tool designed to help you accurately measure the distance you travel by foot. Whether you're hiking, scouting, or engaged in outdoor survival activities, this pace counter ensures you can measure your progress efficiently, even in low-visibility conditions. Its simplicity and effectiveness make it an essential addition to any outdoor adventurer’s gear collection.
